title: Opinion: Opinion | Trump's Midterm Rout Has One More Victim: JD Vance
summary_full: Vance campaigned as hard as the President, served as the Republican National Committee's finance chair. He watched his home state of Ohio elect a Democratic governor and send a Democrat to the Senate seat he gave up to become Vice President.
